topic: Interior Lighting Sub System - DoorFR1 Lamp Breathing Mode Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific breathing rate mode for the front right door lamp, including its code value, period, and associated original breathing mode.

column_semantics.Code Value: The hexadecimal code representing a specific breathing rate mode.
column_semantics.周期: The period (time interval) of the breathing cycle in seconds.
column_semantics.原呼吸模式值: The original breathing mode value associated with this rate, if applicable.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the breathing rate modes for the front right door lamp, specifying how the lamp should breathe based on different command codes. It is used to verify that the lamp correctly implements the specified breathing patterns according to the given command values and periods.
uncertain_points: The exact behavior of the lamp when switching between different breathing modes is not fully detailed.
